assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and to assess for ischemic changes.
The diagnosis of atherosclerotic heart disease is coded I25.10.
The associated symptoms are coded R00.2.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197, indicating that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The provider should be permitted to submit a corrected claim if valid authorization is subsequently secured.
